Privacy Engineering

Our engineers implement the technical side of UU PDP in your business applications, ERP, databases, and infrastructure, working with your IT team or development vendor.

WHO IT IS FOR

Built for teams
like yours.

  • Organizations whose business applications, ERP, or customer apps hold personal data
  • IT teams and development vendors that need UU PDP requirements turned into technical changes
  • Companies whose assessments found gaps in consent, deletion, access, or logging

WHAT’S INCLUDED

What the engagement covers

The exact scope is confirmed in writing before work begins, based on your systems, priorities, and existing work.

01

Personal data discovery

A data dictionary built from your actual schemas and storage, flagging personal and specific personal data and linking it to your records.

02

Consent capture and records

Clear, specific consent options, a record of what each person agreed to and when, and withdrawal that takes effect across your systems.

03

Data-subject requests in your systems

Tools to find, export, correct, and delete one person’s data across databases, storage, and vendors, with every action logged.

04

Retention and deletion

Retention rules turned into scheduled deletion or anonymization, including logs and backups.

05

Access control and audit trails

Role-based access to production data and tamper-resistant logs of who accessed or exported personal data.

06

Encryption and secrets

Encryption in transit and at rest, stronger protection for the most sensitive fields, and credentials removed from source code.

07

Safe non-production data

Masked or synthetic data for development and testing, so real personal data stays in production.

08

Third-party SDK and data-sharing review

An inventory of what each SDK and integration collects, and changes to stop unnecessary sharing.

09

Detection and breach readiness

Alerts for unusual access or export activity and searchable logs to support investigations.

10

Privacy in your change process

A short privacy checklist in your change, feature, and vendor onboarding process, so new work is reviewed before release.

Deliverables your
team can use.

  • Implemented changes with acceptance evidence

01

Compliance inside the product

Consent, data-subject requests, and retention work in your systems, not only on paper.

02

Stronger safeguards

Access control, encryption, and audit trails that protect personal data and support investigations.

03

Verified results

Each change is demonstrated against agreed acceptance criteria and documented for your records.

UU PDP

Obligations this
service supports.

How this service helps you meet the requirements of Law No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection.

  • Consent and lawful processing
  • Data subject rights in practice
  • Retention and deletion
  • Security of personal data
  • Breach detection and response
  • Data minimization

HOW IT WORKS

A clear path
from start to finish.

Every stage has a defined objective, named owners, and documented outputs.

  1. 01

QUESTIONS

Common questions
about this service.

Something else on your mind? Ask our team ↗

Do you change our production systems?

Only through your own change and approval process. We typically prepare changes for your IT team or vendor to review, or work side by side with them.

Which systems do you work with?

Common business applications, ERP and database platforms, file servers, web and mobile apps, and cloud services. We adapt to your existing systems rather than asking you to change them.

Can you work with our outsourced development vendor?

Yes. We can define the requirements and acceptance criteria, review their changes, and verify the result.
